notes.note: Reviewed the main merge and consolidated duplicate managed-policy API descriptions, preserving both published anchors. Traced fetchManagedPolicyStatus through authenticatedFetch and the lazy registry-free managed-policy-status parser: captured requestScope and AbortSignal are forwarded, only 404 maps to none, malformed/error responses throw, readTarget partitions by Station/authority/route generation and the query uses staleTime Infinity. Server enforcement and SDK-version caveats remain. The merged managed-policy query, connection read-target, switcher, connection registry and failure translation selection passed 58/58 in 20.40 seconds; this is focused integration evidence, not physical-device or release qualification.

Bounded review of the main-merge integration delta: the Station switcher retains both managed remote-client pairing restrictions and the shared describeStationFailure path. Exact local cannot-forget refusals from native stationProfileStorage now keep their safe copy, remain non-retryable and do not establish delivery refusal; appended diagnostic text is still hidden. Reviewed owning source and existing connection/pairing/recovery claims; no prose change needed for this delta. Focused switcher, failure translator, registry and SDK integration tests passed 58/58 in 20.40 seconds. No native shell execution or broader provider qualification is inferred.
